name: B4 row-rank ensemble of B3 and NumPy BNNR

components.B3: benchmarks/recess_adapter/official_b3.py row_fusion_scores (frozen configs/b3_row_fusion_v1.json: DP, DK, SK, LD, LS, REV)
components.BNNR: benchmarks/recess_adapter/bnnr_numpy.py BNNRNumpy (benchscofi BNNR preprocessing and defaults alpha=1, beta=10, tol1=2e-3, tol2=1e-5, maxiter=300, bounds [0,1]; Octave call replaced by a line-by-line NumPy port of BNNR.m/svt.m)

fusion: (1 * rowrank(B3) + 2 * rowrank(BNNR)) / 3 within each drug row over all diseases, + 1e-6 x within-row rank of training disease popularity
selection_rule: Stated before running artifacts/b4_dev/dev.py: among ensemble candidates {block 1:1, block 1:2, block 2:1, block 1:3, flat7}, choose the highest mean official Lin's AUC on 10 random_simple development seeds (first 10 integers >= 1 not among the 100 official seeds); exact ties go to the earlier candidate. B3 and BNNRnp alone are references only. The dev harness mirrors the official runner (random_simple split, 5-fold cv_training fold selection by fold-test AUC, Lin's AUC on the validation set).
weakly_correlated: Not evaluated for any B4 candidate: its single outer holdout is the official test set.
disclosure: BNNR port fidelity was checked on the first 3 official random_simple seeds (benchmark/results/bnnr_numpy_fidelity.json: Lin's AUC identical to published BNNR, 0.709043/0.696773/0.749688). That check validated a port of a published method and informed no B4 design choice. After the fidelity check, bnnr_numpy.py gained an optional exact-result disk cache (BNNR_NUMPY_CACHE_DIR) keyed by input SHA-256; the solver code is unchanged. B4's inner B3 is the frozen B3; the post-hoc B3noREV was not a candidate.
